summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The T-REX 2X Inverse DRAM Daily Target ETF (RAMZ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund aims to provide (-2x) inverse exposure to the daily price movement of the Roundhill Memory ETF stock (CBOE: DRAM), less fees and expenses. DRAM is an actively managed ETF, providing exposure to global equity securities of memory companies through stocks and derivatives. RAMZ was launched on Jul 28, 2026 and is issued by Tuttle Capital Management.
